name: htmlDocument
description: Parses an HTML string into an HTML document object that supports CSS selectors. Pass mode "fragment" to parse the markup as a fragment, "document" to force full-document parsing, or omit it to auto-detect (strings that look like a full document are parsed as documents, everything else as a fragment). The returned object exposes select(selector), selectWithin(element, selector), attr(element, name), setAttr(element, name, value), hasAttr, removeAttr, text, innerHTML, outerHTML, tagName, allElements and documentHTML()/toString() to serialise back to HTML.

params.name: mode
params.description: Optional parse mode: fragment or document. Omit to auto-detect.

examples.title: Select elements
examples.description: Parse a fragment and pull out the class of every .item element.
